preserved_distinctions.how: the binding refuses to construct over an empty admitted set unless the receipt carries the truthful first-class outcome, and the adopted receipt owner already pins NO_ADMITTED_SOURCE to COMPLETE coverage. The court exercises both the COMPLETE-no-admitted case and the INCOMPLETE case and pins the refusal codes.
preserved_distinctions.not_collapsed_into: an error, an empty list, or a zero-length success

preserved_distinctions.distinction: applicability NONCOMPARABLE distinct from F8 evidence NONCOMPARABLE
preserved_distinctions.how: non-admitted sources are reported in non_admitted_source_states with their applicability public state and an explicit applicability_noncomparable_is_not_f8_evidence_noncomparable marker, while the F8 result carries its own NONCOMPARABLE / EXACT_POSITIONED_STRATUM_NONCOMPARABLE. The court pins both simultaneously and separately.

preserved_distinctions.distinction: multiple admitted sources remain separate source-indexed entries
preserved_distinctions.how: admitted entries keep one provenance row each, cardinality is flagged as not a sample size, and each source evaluates through F8 independently. The court pins two admitted sources, two provenance rows, and two independent EXACT_SUPPORTED evaluations.
preserved_distinctions.not_collapsed_into: a pooled sample, a composite estimand, or a cross-source aggregate

preserved_distinctions.distinction: F8 exact conditional lookup / strictly-decreasing walkback algorithm byte-unchanged
preserved_distinctions.how: the F8 owner blob is verified by git hash-object inside the court against the HQ208-recorded blob, and evaluate_bound_positioned_subject_possibility calls the adopted evaluator with the caller's own objects
preserved_distinctions.not_collapsed_into: a re-implementation, a wrapper that rewrites inputs, or a re-binding that alters geometry

self_referential_court_avoidance.why: the HQ207 independent review (03/08 artifacts, GAP-3) found that a court parametrised over the SAME constant the production code checks cannot detect a narrowing of that constant, and proves only that the FUNCTION refuses its own list rather than that the DATA carries no authority.
measures_taken_here: every forbidden purpose is PINNED AS AN EXPLICIT LITERAL in the court file and never read from the production tuple, so truncating B.FORBIDDEN_BINDING_PURPOSES makes the court FAIL rather than silently collect fewer cases

the non-authorization property is ADDITIONALLY proven by value inspection of the binding material: a recursive walk asserts that no rank/score/priority/preference/weight/best/first/latest/local leaf or value exists anywhere in the emitted data

'unranked' is proven by PERMUTATION INVARIANCE of the binding replay identity across all 6 orderings of a 3-member candidate class, plus a check that the admitted set order is not derived from input order, rather than by asserting a self-declared boolean
the public surface is pinned against __all__ rather than bare dir(), and separately the set of RETURNING source-touching methods is pinned apart from the RAISING refusal methods

residuals_and_open_items: The binding validates a STATIC exact-release source scope. It makes no comparative, joint, multi-arity, temporal or structural-field claim, and those remain gated on C1 and F7 respectively.

The applicability owner's own court gaps GAP-1, GAP-2, GAP-3 and GAP-4, and its arithmetic error in 04_COURT_RESULTS.json (additional_courts_written claimed 45, actually 32), were found by the adopted review and are NOT repaired by this lane. This lane does not touch that owner. Referred to HQ.
The currentness result is carried as an opaque validated string. This lane does not adjudicate WHICH lifecycle authority may issue one; it only refuses to assert currency it was not given.
